title: Fragmented Markers, Mixed Results: A Systematic Review of AI Coding Assistants and Developer Productivity
abstract: arXiv:2611.21632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding assistants are increasingly embedded in software engineering practice, yet the literature still offers no cumulative, easily interpretable picture of their effects on software developer productivity. The central problem is not a lack of studies, but a lack of comparability: prior work operationalizes productivity through heterogeneous markers, settings, and reporting styles, making cross-study conclusions difficult. To address this, we conduct a staged systematic literature review. In the first stage, we synthesize studies that explicitly examine developer productivity. In the second, we extend the scope to productivity-related developer outcomes using SPACE as a theory-informed lens, capturing human-centered evidence that explicit productivity studies often omit. Across both stages, we analyze how productivity is operationalized, which confounding factors are discussed, and how reported effects are distributed.   We identify

translated_title: 碎片化的指标，喜忧参半的结果：AI编程助手与开发者生产力的系统性综述
translated_abstract: AI编程助手正日益深度融入软件工程实践，然而现有文献仍未形成对其如何影响软件开发者生产力的累积性、易于解读的整体图景。核心问题并非研究的匮乏，而是缺乏可比性：先前的研究通过异质的衡量指标、研究情境和报告风格来操作化生产力概念，导致跨研究得出结论十分困难。为解决这一问题，我们开展了一项分阶段的系统性文献综述。在第一阶段，我们综合了明确考察开发者生产力的研究；在第二阶段，我们以SPACE框架作为有理论依据的视角，将研究范围扩展至与生产力相关的开发者成果，捕捉显性生产力研究常常忽略的以人为本的证据。在两个阶段中，我们分析了生产力是如何被操作化的、讨论了哪些混淆因素，以及已报告的效果呈现怎样的分布。
tldr: 该论文通过一项分阶段的系统性文献综述，指出现有AI编程助手对开发者生产力影响研究的核心问题在于生产力衡量指标碎片化、缺乏可比性，并基于SPACE框架将分析范围扩展至以人为本的生产力相关成果。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a staged systematic literature review showing that fragmented, heterogeneous productivity markers hinder cross-study comparability in research on AI coding assistants, and uses the SPACE framework as a theory-informed lens to capture human-centered, productivity-related developer outcomes.
